messages:
maya-peopleops: @samira-candidate quick thread to lock down logistics for your APAC virtual interview next Wed. You prefer 09:00 IST. Need captions, India dial-in, and panel availability.

samira-candidate: 09:00 IST works. Request live captions + India dial-in. I might ask for a short extra break during the loop.

sam-patel: 09:00 IST is fine for me. How long will the interview be?

jordan-lee: Target 60m with 15m buffer. Prebrief at 08:45 IST for roles + rubric. Panel = Sam, Jordan, Mei (PM APAC), Aria (ENG-US).

lisa-office: I can provision +91 dial-in and enable transcript export. Recommend a 10-min test call the evening before to verify captions and dial-in.

maya-peopleops: Samira, can you do a 10-min test call Tue 20:00 IST?

samira-candidate: Yes, Tue 20:00 IST works. Thanks.

calendar-bot: Tentative invite created: "Candidate Interview - Samira" 2026-06-10 09:00 IST (Status: tentative).

maya-peopleops: I'll confirm after Aria (PST) confirms. Adding accessibility note and consent for transcript to the invite.

lisa-office: India dial-in set: +91 22 6123 0000 (PIN 8421). Transcript consent checkbox added. Reimbursement form attached if candidate incurs costs.

jordan-lee: Prebrief checklist in invite: roles, rubric link, accessibility reminders, fallback plan (short take-home if connection drops).

sam-patel: All good from my side.

maya-peopleops: Final confirmed invite will be posted here once Aria confirms. :thumbsup:
